attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) to serve DHCP on lan-a (10.50.10.0/24, gateway 10.50.10.1) via Kea DHCPv4, and node2 (OPNsense) to serve DHCP on lan-b (10.50.20.0/24, gateway 10.50.20.1) via dnsmasq. node3 (eth1, lan-a) and node4 (eth1, lan-b) already had NetworkManager configured for DHCP (ipv4.method auto) on their second NIC and now obtain their address and default route dynamically from their respective router rather than static config. All 4 nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, with boot-identity changes confirmed and post-restart recovery verified (DHCP services active, static router-side addressing persisted across reboot, and both node3 and node4 automatically re-acquired the same leases with correct default routes to their segment's router).
